comparison_design_and_cost.where: Service.probePublic / probePrivate (health.go), in every process, on IPFS_HEALTH_PROBE_INTERVAL — not inherited from the leader's VerifyPins sweep
comparison_design_and_cost.cost_per_process_per_swarm_per_interval: one pin/ls?type=recursive (bounded by ipfs.Client.ListPins: 16 MiB body, 100k entries, a larger pinset errors) plus one bounded live-CID read (SELECT DISTINCT cid over pinned/pending/unpinning, LIMIT 100001) — roughly 6 MB of transient strings at the cap; two roles list the node twice per interval instead of once
comparison_design_and_cost.dedupe: countStrays is one free function with no logging, called by verifyNetwork (leader) and by strayPins (every process's probe); the repair writes and the single actionable ipfs_stray_pins WARN stay leader-only
comparison_design_and_cost.capped_case: reported ABSENT, not as a floor. A short ledger read leaves live CIDs out of the accounted set, so their node pins are counted as strays: the error runs UPWARD and 'N+' would be a false floor under an over-count. This is the rule verify.go already applied to a truncated pinset
comparison_design_and_cost.deviation_from_brief: the live-CID read is ONE bounded query rather than 500-row keyset pages iterated to completion: paging a DISTINCT set would be ~200 round trips per process per interval instead of one, and the '+' marker the brief suggested is unavailable in the over-count direction
